verdict.rationale: The installer writes skills into your repo as ordinary, editable files you own, so every installed instruction file can be read afterward (docs-24, docs-47, docs-2). Before installing, the skill catalog and the raw SKILL.md files are publicly browsable, and the docs say you pick which skills to install (docs-43, docs-5). A community reader reports learning from reading the skill files (comm-1). However, pre-install review means manually browsing the repo rather than using an installer listing or preview. Missing for 10: a documented pre-install manifest or dry-run listing of the files a skill will add, explicit documentation of any bundled scripts beyond SKILL.md, and clarity on how to inspect the read-only plugin-bundle install route.
